companyProfile.title: Company profile
companyProfile.description: Registration number, turnover by year, references, certificates – input for AI analysis of tenders.

notifications.heading: Email notifications
notifications.newTendersHelp: A summary of new tenders sent to your email.
notifications.emailsHelp: One or more addresses separated by commas – notifications will go to all of them. If left empty, your login email ({{email}}) will be used. Max 10 recipients.
notifications.frequencyHelp: How often you'd like to receive a summary of new tenders.
notifications.deadlineRemindersHelp: Email 3 days and 1 day before the deadline for saved tenders.
notifications.grantsHelp: A different cadence than for tenders – the list changes more slowly.
notifications.grantNewMatchLabel: New match with a grant radar
notifications.grantNewMatchHelp: Email whenever a call matching one of your grant radars appears.
notifications.grantWeeklyHelp: Friday summary of new and open calls based on your radars.
notifications.grantDeadlineHelp: Only for one-shot calls (with a fixed deadline), 7 and 2 days before the end.

radars.heading: Radars
radars.description: Each radar has its own keywords, CPV categories and regions. A tender appears if it matches at least one active radar.
radars.empty: You don't have any radar yet. Add your first one.
radars.mustKeepOne: At least one radar must remain.
radars.deleteTitleDisabled: At least one radar must remain
radars.skRegionsHelp: Leave empty for all of Slovakia, or choose specific regions.

subscription.heading: Subscription
subscription.confirmCancel: Cancel subscription? You'll keep access until the end of the paid period.
subscription.cancelRequestedNote: Cancellation requested. Access remains until the end of the paid period.
subscription.paymentsNote: Payments are processed by GoPay. Details can be found in the {{link}}.

billing.heading: Billing details
billing.description: Used to issue an invoice after the subscription is paid. The invoice will be sent to your billing email.
billing.nameRequired: Please enter a name or company name.

onboarding.title: Set up your filters
onboarding.description: A tender will show up if its title/description contains a keyword or matches a CPV code, and the region matches.
onboarding.keywordsRequired: Enter at least one keyword or CPV category.

step2.heading: 2. CPV categories
step2.description: Select the main divisions you're interested in.

step3.heading: 3. Countries
step3.description: Which EU countries to track? Slovakia is selected by default.

step4.heading: 4. Regions (Slovakia) – optional
step4.description: Leave empty for all of Slovakia, or choose specific regions.

firma.title: Company profile
firma.description: AI compares this information with tender requirements during "Analyze tender".

companies.heading: My companies
companies.description: You can add several companies and switch between them. The main company is the one used by AI analysis of tenders and grants.
companies.deleteConfirm: Really delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
companies.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
companies.defaultHint: The main company cannot be deleted. Set another company as main first.

identification.heading: Identification
identification.description: Enter your registration number and load data from RPO + registeruz.sk.

financials.heading: Turnover and employees by year
financials.description: AI compares this with the "average annual turnover for the last 3 years" requirement.

references.heading: References
references.description: A list of significant contracts – AI compares the count and value.

push.heading: In-app notifications
push.description: New tenders matching your radars, deadline reminders for saved tenders, and completed AI analyses. Respects your settings above.
push.denied: Permission denied. Enable it in your phone's settings.
push.deniedNote: Notification permission is denied – it can only be changed in your phone's system settings.

grantRadars.heading: Grant radars
grantRadars.description: Monitoring of grant calls from ITMS21+. A new match arrives by email; deadline reminders only for one-shot calls. Available in both Basic and Premium.
grantRadars.empty: You don't have any grant radar yet. Add your first one.
grantRadars.autoFillCategory: We will automatically pre-fill the applicant type based on your profile: {{category}}.

applicantType.heading: Applicant type
applicantType.hint: If you don't select any type, all will be included.

regions.heading: Regions
regions.hint: Nationwide calls are always included automatically.

format.heading: Call format
format.hint: Unselected = both. "Rolling" = no deadline, "One-shot" = fixed deadline.

adminDelete.title: Delete account {{email}}?
adminDelete.isAdmin: An admin account cannot be deleted.
adminDelete.willDelete: The following will be permanently deleted:
adminDelete.invoicesWarning: This account has {{count}} issued invoices. Invoices stay in the system for accounting purposes, but the account and all other data will be deleted.
adminDelete.forceCheckbox: Delete the account despite the invoices
adminDelete.understandCheckbox: I understand this action is irreversible

dangerZone.heading: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting your account is irreversible. You will lose all radars, saved tenders, AI analyses and settings.

step1.title: Do you really want to delete your account?
step1.intro: The following will be permanently deleted:
step1.invoicesNote: Issued invoices remain in the system due to legal archiving requirements.

step2.title: Final warning
step2.warning: This is the final warning. Your account and all data will be permanently deleted.
step2.checkbox: I understand that my account and all data will be permanently deleted

errors.emailMismatch: The e-mail you entered does not match.
errors.cancelSubscriptionFirst: Cancel your recurring subscription in the Subscription & billing section first, then you can delete the account.
errors.adminAccount: An admin account cannot be deleted via self-service, please contact support.
